philosophy.role: Environmental physics — HOW MUCH to trust V01-V06 signals
philosophy.no_normalization: Raw levels only. No z-score, no regime label transforms. Schwert (1989): vol is persistent (AR=0.8994), raw level IS the information.

vix_close.description: Raw CBOE VIX daily close — same value for ALL tickers on a given date
vix_close.lookahead_guard: Intraday resolutions (15min, 1hour) use PREVIOUS day's VIX close via .shift(1). Daily/weekly use same-day close (published at market close).
vix_close.research: Whaley (2000) JPM 26(3): VIX = forward-looking 30-day implied vol. Raw close IS state.

atr_pct.description: Wilder ATR(14) / Close × 100 — per-ticker idiosyncratic volatility
atr_pct.research: Ang et al. (2006) JF 61(1): idiosyncratic vol (ATR%) is orthogonal to systematic vol (VIX). Both dimensions needed.

parkinson_vol.description: Range-based volatility estimator, 2.5-5× more efficient than close-to-close
parkinson_vol.formula: σ = sqrt( mean(ln(H/L)²) / (4·ln2) ) over rolling window
parkinson_vol.research: Parkinson (1980) JBus 53(1): uses intrabar price range, capturing more information per observation.

atr_expansion_ratios.description: ATR(14) / SMA(ATR, window) — ratio > 1.0 indicates expanding volatility
atr_expansion_ratios.interpretation: Compressing (<0.8) → coiled spring. Expanding (>1.2) → regime shift in progress.

complacent.interpretation: Adrian & Brunnermeier (2016): low VIX = hidden systemic risk accumulating. Volatility paradox.

normal.interpretation: Baseline regime. Signals interpreted at face value.

elevated.interpretation: Risk-off. God Model should compress confidence toward 0.5 neutral.

extreme.interpretation: Crisis. Squeeze-and-Excitation gate should heavily attenuate all signal confidence.

compressed.interpretation: Low idiosyncratic vol. Breakout imminent or dead stock.

volatile.interpretation: Elevated per-ticker risk. Position sizing should shrink.

distressed.interpretation: Extreme idiosyncratic event. Signal reliability degraded.

compressing.interpretation: Vol declining vs baseline. Coiled spring — watch for breakout.

stable.interpretation: Vol near its own average. Normal operating regime.

expanding.interpretation: Vol rising vs baseline. Trend acceleration or regime change.

exploding.interpretation: Vol spike. Likely news-driven. Reduce exposure.

G0_SYSTEMATIC.research: Ang et al. (2006): VIX gates ALL chart pattern interpretation. Adrian & Brunnermeier (2016): volatility paradox — low VIX may mean hidden risk, not safety.
G0_SYSTEMATIC.mechanism: VIX level modulates how much to trust CNN visual pattern recognition. High VIX → compress CNN confidence toward uniform prior.

G1_STRUCTURAL.research: VIX + range position jointly gate how RSI/MACD/Volume signals are interpreted. A bullish RSI divergence in a VIX=40 environment means something different than in VIX=12.
G1_STRUCTURAL.mechanism: XGBoost interaction constraints ensure VIX can modulate numerical signal weights but cannot directly predict returns.

G2_LOCAL.research: Ang et al. (2006): idiosyncratic vol is orthogonal to systematic. A stock with ATR%=8% in a VIX=15 environment has ticker-specific risk that VIX doesn't capture.
G2_LOCAL.mechanism: Per-ticker ATR% gates THAT ticker's own signals. High ATR% → reduce confidence in all signals for that specific ticker.

conditional_gating.behavior: V07 sensors are NOT fed as raw inputs alongside V01-V06. They recalibrate CNN features BEFORE the decision layer. High-risk regime squeezes confidence toward 0.5 neutral.
conditional_gating.warning: NEVER conflate V07/V08 with standard numerical variables. They are Ghost/State variables with a fundamentally different role in the architecture.

research_citations: Whaley (2000) JPM 26(3) — VIX fear gauge, forward-looking implied vol
Parkinson (1980) JBus 53(1) — Range estimator 2.5-5× more efficient
Schwert (1989) JF 44(5) — Vol persistent AR=0.8994, no z-score needed
Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang (2006) JF 61(1) — Systematic ⊥ idiosyncratic
Adrian & Brunnermeier (2016) AER 106(7) — Volatility paradox: low VIX = hidden risk
